title: useField
subtitle: Fine-grained field subscription
description: Subscribe to one path. Ideal for leaf inputs in large forms.

examples.title: Nested path
Bound hooks variant
examples.code:
// after createResourceHooks(...)
const { value, onChange, onBlur, error } = useField('pricing.basePrice');

behavior.title: onBlur touches
behavior.description: Calls resource.touch(path) so blur-mode validation can run.
